messages:
alex_support: FYI customer reports spikes and requests routing to us-west even though they set X-Client-Region: "eu". Seen for last 6 hours, billing blowup. Attach logs below.
sofia_support: Can you paste the raw header capture from their side? asking whether any proxies are in front. :thinking_face: 
alex_support: They sent a pcap and a curl from their edge:
```
curl -v -H "X-Client-Region:  eu" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions
```
alex_support: note there's a non-breaking-space (U+00A0) just before eu, customer says it appeared after they upgraded a proxy config.
maria_sre: that could explain router ignoring header. our router does strict equality check for region token, doesn't trim NBSP. will check routing logs.
josh_infra: pulling router logs for that customer org id 0123... searching for requests with header values that include non-printable/nbsp.
josh_infra: found ~1200 requests with header exactly " eu" between 02:10–08:30 UTC, all routed to nearest-pop (us-west) because header didn't match our whitelist.
sofia_support: customer sees 200 OK but high p50/p95 latency due to cross-region. they assumed header=eu would route to eu edge.
maria_sre: hypothesis: proxy upgrade started injecting non-breaking-space. our header normalization pipeline trims normal whitespace but not NBSP. quickfix: update normalization to unicode-strip NBSP and other common non-breaking spaces. longer: teach router to norm Unicode NFKC/NFKD before matching.
josh_infra: repro locally:
```
# simulate header with NBSP
printf "GET /v1/ping HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.redwood.ai\r\nX-Client-Region:  eu\r\n\r\n" | nc api-router 80
# router logs: region_header=" eu" -> fallback to nearest-pop
```
maria_sre: creating canary patch to strip   and NBSP variants at parsing layer. will deploy to router-canary in prod and validate metric: misrouted_by_header_count.
sofia_support: told customer initial finding, asked them to roll back proxy change for now or add header without NBSP as hotfix. they agreed to temp rollback. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started: router-canary/normalize-nbsp v2026.3.1 -> prod-canary (instances: 3)
maria_sre: monitoring canary, looking at requests from affected org. if canary shows correct routing for those headers, we'll push wider. ETA 30m.
josh_infra: also adding lint in SDKs and curl snippets to call out invisible chars when copying headers from GUIs.
\alex_support: logging escalation summary in ticket and flagging billing team to invoice-adjust if we confirm customer overbilled because of misroute.
sofia_support: nice, I'll keep customer updated and get confirmation when they test a curl without NBSP.
maria_sre: followup action items: 1) immediate canary with NBSP trimming 2) router matching fuzz tests for unicode whitespace 3) docs note about invisible characters in header values 4) consider server-side metric and alert for suspicious header chars.
josh_infra: adding acceptance test: send header variants (normal space, NBSP, ZWSP, BOM) and assert normalized region=="eu".
\alex_support: thanks team, will close thread when billing decision and canary successful. :white_check_mark:
